analysis: Observed production request structure; no measured cache hits or latency

methods.history: only strictly earlier arrivals; no generated-output hashes or completion assumptions
methods.historical_retention: unbounded observed input history; structural opportunity only
methods.session_unit: connected parent component; no observed terminal status
methods.observation_interval: [0, floor(max_timestamp)+1); final partial bins excluded from count dispersion
methods.cooccurrence: current reuse >= threshold; earlier long input >= cohort p90 in a different component within window
methods.short_variant: also requires current input <= cohort median
methods.temporal_thirds: fixed thirds; retain pre-window observed history; components may cross boundaries
methods.population: entire pinned Trace A; no random sampling or synthetic records
